* '''[http://xorxes.110mb.com/LPP.html le cmalu noltru]''' &mdash; ''Le Petit Prince'', by Antoine de Saint-Exupéry, translated by [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/xorxes xorxes].
* '''[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/lo+nu+binxo lo nu binxo]''' &mdash; ''The Metamorphosis'', by Franz Kafka, translated by [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/xorxes xorxes].
